title: BIM / VDC Specialist - (Electrical Construction)
job_description:
Metro Tech Electric Inc. is seeking a talented and detail-oriented Virtual Design Construction (VDC) Specialist to join our dynamic team. This is a great opportunity to join a rapidly growing company, with exponential advancement opportunities. Be one of the driving forces that shapes the Metro Tech Constructability Department. We Pride ourselves on the expertise each one of the professionals at Metro Tech brings to the table.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in electrical design, with proficiency in creating schematics and layouts for various projects. Candidates must have advanced knowledge of the required software (Revit MEP, Navisworks, Bluebeam, BIM 360 Glue, G Suite, Microsoft Teams, etc.). This position works in a team environment and must be able to effectively collaborate verbally and in writing, be reliable and possess a positive work ethic, and have strong problem-solving skills as well as interpersonal and communication skills.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

Must have a desire to work in a team-based environment and contribute immediately.
5 years field and/or technical experience with 3-4 years of software experience
5 years’ experience in Virtual Design Construction within the Electrical Field.
Proficient in BlueBeam, Revit, AutoCAD, BIM 360, Navisworks, and Microsoft Suite software
Proficiency within the Microsoft Suite (Office 365 and One Drive included)
Mission Critical experience is a plus!

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Comprehends, navigates, and utilizes design, construction, and submittal documentation to create and maintain in-house complete installation drawings. Ability to identify, produce/document complete prefabrication drawings for the prefabrication staff. Also, the ability to capture BOM’s for prefabrication assemblies using schedules for components within Revit software.
Tracks changes by design team or others and understands the impact/cost/timeframe it will have on project.
Works within the established Metro Tech Electric Field, Shop and Constructability standards.
Create modeled content of electrical components and related content to ensure accurate dimensions, orientation, and elevation with minimal guidance.
Creates, modifies, and maintains detailed 2D and 3D installation documentation.
Provides forecast on assigned work with oversight of Supervisor and completes work within estimated hours.
Working knowledge on best practices and communications requirements with others to maintain Electrical systems modeled content to be clash free in a multi-discipline environment/project.
Effectively communicates with team members and project stakeholders to keep all team members aware of all VDC Department challenges and development ideas.
Provides detailed input into tasked assignments and project tracking.
Maintains accountability through task management and tracking.
Ability to coordinate with other sub-contractors, General Contractors, Vendors and Field personnel.
Manages project file sharing process for any given assigned project.
Adheres to BIM Execution Plan (BEP) and BIM project workflow criteria defined by Metro Tech and or BIM Execution Plans (BEP) from an external client BIM Coordinator.
Performs other related duties as required and assigned.

*The job description and responsibilities described are intended to provide guidelines for job expectations and the employee's ability to perform the position described. It is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all functions, responsibilities, skills, and abilities. Additional functions and requirements may be assigned by supervisors as deemed appropriate. *

It is our policy to attract and retain the best-qualified people available, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability or status as a Special Disabled Veteran, Vietnam Era Veteran, or other qualifying veteran.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: From $110,000.00 per year

Benefits:

401(k)
401(k) matching
Dental insurance
Employee assistance program
Health insurance
Life insurance
Paid time off
Referral program
Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

Do you have any Mission Critical / Data Center experience within Electrical VDC?

Experience:

Constructability: 3 years (Preferred)
Data center: 1 year (Required)
Electrical Construction (field and/or VDC): 5 years (Required)
Revit: 3 years (Required)
Electrical design: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote
